caption: The video captures a tight close-up of a transparent glass mug with a handle on the left, held by bare fingers and filled nearly to the brim with a dark hot beverage. A bright out-of-focus light glows upper-left, throwing a lens flare and a greenish-blue circular artifact across the liquid surface against a dark background. Wisps of steam are already rising from the drink. A faint puff drifting up from the rim center thickens into a vertical column, then thins and tilts leftward toward the light before dispersing. New wisps reappear and continue curling upward and sideways, showing steady, unbroken evaporation. The liquid surface itself stays still, with the fill level and rim position constant. The hand, mug, and green flare remain fixed, so all apparent motion comes from the rising steam.
